title: window.history
description: The browser's history, `window.history`: each page is an entry at its address, pushed or replaced by `navigate` and read back by `useLocation`; a page notes where it was in its entry's state (`noteInEntry`, read with `entryState`), which Back and Forward bring back.

title: lathe:space
description: `lathe:space`, in local storage so it is kept from one launch to the next, names the space chosen last; `lathe:space-pages`, in session storage, holds each space's last page by product ID. Both are read when the shell starts and written as the page moves, and a stored page that is not a space's page is dropped.

title: lathe:nav-folders
description: `lathe:nav-folders`, in session storage, holds the stage and folder rows the Reader has open or folded, by row key; `lathe:nav-sections`, in local storage, the nav's own sections. Each is read when the nav is drawn and written on each toggle, and a stored value of any other form is dropped.

title: lathe:tabs
description: `lathe:tabs` in session storage, per space, read with `parseTabSet`: the desktop app's tabs. On the web, where each browser tab is one place, its view (depth, kind filters, wiki card) is kept under `lathe:place` in the browser tab's own session storage, read by `usePlace` (app/src/views/usePlace.ts).

title: lathe:session-settings
description: `lathe:session-settings`, in session storage, holds the session's settings: the graph's layout, depth, hidden kinds and minimap; the wiki card's open state, width and whether it shows its whole page; the chat's open state and width; and the Changes lens, its baseline, Follow and when each product was last looked at. `sessionSettings` reads it again only when the stored text changes and drops a value in any other form for the defaults; `saveSessionSettings` writes it and tells every reader.

title: readPref
description: Keeps each panel's size and whether it shows as JSON in local storage under its own keys (`lathe:nav-width`, `lathe:nav-collapsed`), read as the panel mounts and written on each change (`readPref`, `writePref`, `usePanelSize`); the app works on without storage. The wiki card's width is the session's settings (LA-EXP-A6).

title: COMMANDS
description: Keeps the commands and their default keys in the code (`COMMANDS`, with the `SPACE_KEYS` space commands), and the person's own bindings by command ID as JSON in local storage under `lathe:keybindings`, read once as the app starts (`readOverrides`); the app never writes them.

title: themeStore
description: Keeps the person's own themes, the chosen theme's ID, the color mode and the chosen theme's stylesheet as JSON in local storage (`STORAGE_KEYS`: `lathe:themes`, `lathe:theme`, `lathe:color-mode`, `lathe:theme-css`), loaded once as the app starts and saved after each change (`themeStore`); a stored theme that `parseTheme` refuses is dropped. The built-in themes are in the code (`BUILT_IN_THEMES`).

title: parseWindowStates
description: Keeps each window's place by folder as JSON in window-state.json in the shell's user data folder, read as the shell starts (`parseWindowStates`) and rewritten on each save (`saveWindow`); the chrome colors are in chrome.json beside it, and the window's server and error count only in memory.

title: open
description: The map of open windows (open): each entry holds its window's server (entry.server) while the shell runs.

title: parseRecent
description: Keeps the recent folders, latest first, as a JSON list in recent-folders.json in the shell's user data folder, read as the shell starts (`parseRecent`) and rewritten whenever the list changes (`rememberRecent`).

title: loadConfig
description: Keeps the product repo as `lathe.config.json` in its root folder: the schema version its data is for and where its data files are. `loadConfig` reads it on each load and refuses data for another schema version; `readConfig` reads it whatever the version, for `lathe upgrade`.

title: Store
description: The store module, one `Store` generic over every table: it persists the Product aggregate, and every other aggregate of Authoring, Checking and Traceability as recorded exceptions, each in its own data files: `openStore` and `Store` (load, `rows`, `record`, writes), with the data file form (`rows.ts`), loading order (`insert.ts`), the schema description (`schema.ts`), the product's own kinds (`product-kinds.ts`), validation and merging.
